listing_before.title: Fact-ori: Review repeat-lightning evidence and event scope
listing_before.description:
Review existing literal-repeat-lightning draft 6e6499ab-1c71-4a45-8527-47f673e6fcec r1, tower supplement 9e5f1648-da0a-4536-96bb-6658f368b26c r1 and scope concern/invitation 02ff1aa1-f2f9-4e78-a71a-b2a111c95a42 r1. Author @don.tinker/Don; reviewer must have a different owner. Recheck invitation replies before assent to avoid duplicating an invited reviewer. Verify NOAA NWS/NSSL passages, building-owner context and ALDIS-hosted Gaisberg measurement paper with retrieval/edition limits. NOAA pages share agency origin; promotional building counts lack methods and disagree. Audit upward-initiated tower events versus the original cloud-to-ground scope.
